title: Northgate Benefits on Northgate Marketplace Items
content:
**Rule.** Under Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee, only Fulfilled by Northgate items share Northgate's own benefits: where the program's membership delivery benefit setting is Yes, the membership delivery benefit applies to the order's shipping under the membership delivery benefit rule of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, and where the program's cardholder discount setting is Yes, the Northgate Card discount applies under the cardholder benefit rules of Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.). Items from every other seller program pay the seller's prices and shipping with no membership benefit and no cardholder discount. No marketplace item earns Northgate Cash, qualifies for Northgate price adjustment or price match, or can be covered by a Northgate Protect plan; those three settings are No on every program.

**Benefit by program family.**

| Benefit | Fulfilled by Northgate | Every other seller program |
|---|---|---|
| Membership delivery benefit on shipping | applies | does not apply |
| Northgate Card cardholder discount | applies | does not apply |
| Northgate Cash earning | none | none |
| Price adjustment or price match | none | none |
| Northgate Protect plan cover | none | none |
